evals.name: missing-python-notice-runs-the-read-only-check
evals.prompt: A disk-hygiene hook notice says Python is missing. Is a supported Python 3 available for the disk-hygiene guard here?
evals.expected_output: Reads the setup skill's check section, runs only that check, and reports its PASS/FAIL/INFO table, including the Python interpreter ladder. Installs nothing and stops.
expectations: Follows only the `check` section of /disk-hygiene:setup and reports its PASS/FAIL/INFO table
Resolves the Python 3 interpreter ladder and reports the absolute path of the interpreter it selects, or a FAIL naming the floor
Does not run `apply` and does not install Python, Node or bash
Stops after the table instead of continuing into remediation

evals.name: install-request-is-routed-not-performed
evals.prompt:
/disk-hygiene:check

The check failed. Just install Python for me.
evals.expected_output: Does not install from this skill. Names /disk-hygiene:setup apply as the route for an explicit remediation request.
expectations: Does not install Python or any other tool itself
Names /disk-hygiene:setup apply as the route when the user asks to resolve the failures
Does not claim Python is now installed

evals.name: passing-check-has-no-successor
evals.expected_output: When node, bash and a supported Python resolve, reports PASS and stops without suggesting setup apply.
expectations: Reports the PASS/FAIL/INFO table from the check section, including node, bash and the selected Python interpreter
On a PASS, does not suggest /disk-hygiene:setup apply
